verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows SDKs for Rust, TypeScript, Go, and Python plus an MCP server and HTTP API, but there is no mention anywhere of maintained integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or any other RAG/agent framework. Community feedback even highlights the bespoke HelixQL query language as a barrier to easy LLM/agent tooling integration, reinforcing the absence of such first-class connectors.
